text:
Jun Park: CI is red on macos-builder after the gcc image bump. quick link failure on //src/agents:agents_bin
Jun Park: error: undefined reference to `vtable for AgentManager'
Jun Park: full snippet:
```
/opt/host/bin/ld: bazel-out/darwin-fastbuild/bin/src/agents/_objs/agents_bin/main.o: in function `main':
main.cpp:(.text+0x10): undefined reference to `AgentManager::AgentManager()'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
Samir Patel: ugh. repro locally?
Jun Park: can't repro on my Mac — only happens on CI macos-builder-2 (darwin image: gcc-13.1.0). tried a rebuild, same link error.
Ashley Kim: @Samir can you trigger a rerun for that shard? maybe transient.
ci-bot: rebuild started for buildkite job #7241 (macos-builder-2)
Samir Patel: rerun done — same error. looks deterministic on that image.
Leo Zhang: could be missing -fvisibility or a symbol mangling change with the new toolchain. any recent objc/clang flags modified?
Jun Park: not that I see. This target is C++ only. Bazel toolchain rolled on 1956010000 with gcc -> 13.1.0 image.
Maria Gomez: @eng-infra FYI might need to bisect the image roll. If it's toolchain-caused we should pin back.
Samir Patel: I'll try building the link step with verbose flags on CI to get the exact linker cmd.
Jun Park: thx. adding the command here so we can reproduce:
```
bazel build --config=darwin //src/agents:agents_bin --sandbox_debug -s
```
Samir Patel: good. if it's a missing object, the -s output will show which .o isn't in the archive.
Ashley Kim: another angle — could be LTO/visibility default changed. try setting --cxxopt='-fno-lto' and see.
Leo Zhang: also try adding -Wl,--no-undefined to catch earlier.
Samir Patel: running a debug build with --cxxopt='-fno-lto' on the CI runner now.
ci-bot: build #7241 (rerun-verbose) finished — FAILED in 2m 18s
Jun Park: paste of linker line: `/opt/host/bin/ld ... -Lbazel-out/darwin-fastbuild/bin/src/agents -lagents_internal -o agents_bin`
Jun Park: looks like libagents_internal doesn't include AgentManager symbol. maybe broken by symbol visibility change.
Maria Gomez: if it's definitely the image, we should create a rollback PR for the image tag and run smoke. can someone bisect between 1956010000 and previous?
Samir Patel: I'm starting a bisect pipeline: will iterate the image tags and run the link step only. cc @Jun Park
Jun Park: appreciate it. if bisect shows image as culprit we can pin to previous image and open infra rollback.
Ashley Kim: if you need a quick patch, we can also force-export the symbol on that lib as temporary workaround. but prefer tracking root cause. :+1:
Samir Patel: initial bisect result — good build on gcc-12.2.0, failure on gcc-13.1.0. narrowing now to minor revisions.
Jun Park: thanks. keep updates here. I'll open an issue with logs and add the failed CI link.
Maria Gomez: ping infra owners if bisect confirms. also add a note to the release channel so teams expecting darwin builds know.
Samir Patel: bisect narrowed to a runtime lib change in the image (libstdc++ variant). filing infra bug with diff and attaching artifact.
Jun Park: ok going to mark the PR blocked until infra makes a decision. thx all. :wave:
